demo.title: Try Ubeya with example data
demo.description: Creates example shifts and earnings only. No Ubeya login or network requests will be made.

live.title: Ubeya Crew phone number
live.description: Enter your phone number in international format with country code (for example, 447xxxxxxxxx). On the next screen, request a fresh SMS on the official Ubeya Crew website, ideally in a private browser window. Ubeya's reCAPTCHA must be completed on its own website.

otp.title: Verify with Ubeya Crew
otp.description: Visit {crew_url} in a private browser window and request a new login SMS. Complete Ubeya's reCAPTCHA there. **Do not submit the SMS code on the Ubeya site.** Enter that fresh code here instead. This cross-client login method is experimental and may not be accepted by Ubeya. Never share the code with anyone or paste it into a support message.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Ubeya Crew
reauth_confirm.description: Ubeya's session has expired. Request a fresh SMS through Ubeya's official site, then enter it in Home Assistant to reconnect.

error.invalid_phone: Enter an international phone number using digits and a country code.
error.invalid_code: Ubeya rejected this code or it is invalid or expired. Request a fresh one on the official site.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Ubeya. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: Ubeya did not provide usable session cookies. Its sign-in flow may not support this method.

abort.already_configured: This Ubeya account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: The phone number does not match the configured Ubeya account
